content.title: Coherent (NYSE:COHR) Reports Bullish Q3, Stock Soars
content.summary: Materials and photonics company Coherent (NYSE:COHR) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 17.3% year on year to $1.58 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($1.63 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 4.9% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.16 per share was 11.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
